verified.hardware: nvidia_grace_blackwell (Dell Pro Max GB300, GB300 only; RTX PRO 2000 display GPU not used)
verified.smoke: tool call (get_weather) ok; single stream decode p50 340.9 tok/s, TTFT p90 0.19 s
notes: Measured with the kit's agent concurrency bench (coder/solstice method, doc-check reviews), launched as an llm-helper profile with this image and these flags; the recipes launch path itself was not run on the GB300.
Interactive limit (p90 TTFT <= 10 s, p10 decode >= 15 tok/s): 32 reviews, 55.6 concurrent chats, 36.0 concurrent calls.
Autonomous plateau: 32 reviews, 8588.0 turns/hour; users chatting ~83.0.

Results: fastest single stream of the set (decode p50 341 tok/s, TTFT p90 0.19 s) and the highest throughput (8,588 turns/hour at 32 reviews). It also degrades gracefully: at 64 reviews (118 chats, 83 calls) it still did 8,340 turns/hour with p90 TTFT 1.9 s, KV only 70% full and prefix hit 0.73 — sliding-window attention keeps KV per token small, which matters on this KV-bound workload. The interactive rule failed at 64 by a hair (p10 decode 14.6 tok/s vs 15). At 96 it saturated (KV {"kvmax":0.995773692664644,"hit":0.21081244486196818}, 4,620 turns/hour). Errors: context-length 400s only (1-9% per step) from the one doc-check review longer than its 131k context; counted as errors, never above the 20% stop rule. Caveats for a demo: no vision input, 131k context (long agent sessions need compaction).
